game_title: Capstone Boss Chain – Camel Trail Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Sand Dunes – Camel Trail, a camel trail: the oasis keeper must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Capstone Boss Chain: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks.
theme: Sand Dunes – Camel Trail: a camel trail
core_gameplay_loop: In Camel Trail, repeat each round: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the boss_hp value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about boss_hp to power up the oasis keeper and open the caravan wagon.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Capstone Boss Chain
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Capstone Boss Chain' (Week 9 slot 15), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Camel Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how boss_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against scarab swarms in Camel Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
